query:
ALTER TABLE users 
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS grade ENUM('junior1','junior2','junior3','senior1','senior2','senior3'),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS school VARCHAR(200),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS userType ENUM('student','parent','teacher') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'student',
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS region VARCHAR(100),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS currentSemester ENUM('first','second'),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS disabledMenuItems JSON,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS email_verified TINYINT DEFAULT 0,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS wechat_open_id VARCHAR(128),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS wechat_nickname VARCHAR(200),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS theme ENUM('light','dark','system') DEFAULT 'system',
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS points INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS total_feedback_count INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL;
